versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-video-copy.

- Supports converting videos (local files or public links) to clean, readable text.
- Features automatic removal of filler words, errors, and repetitive content.
- Customizable output styles via prompts, including summaries, highlights, and platform-specific rewrites.
- Covers scenarios like transcription, subtitle extraction, meeting summaries, course breakdowns, and creative script generation.
- Requires configuration of GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN and supports Node.js 16.14.0+ on all major OS platforms.
